en.text:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.

Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.

Grants <pve 1% /> <pvp [0.35%] /> Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to <pve 100% /> <pvp [35%] /> at 100 Melee Stat. 

Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of <pve 200% /> <pvp [70%] /> energy.
